reading.title: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence has revolutionized modern healthcare by improving diagnostic accuracy and treatment outcomes. AI algorithms can analyze medical images such as X-rays and MRIs faster than human radiologists, detecting diseases like cancer at earlier stages. Additionally, AI-powered systems assist in drug discovery by identifying potential compounds that could treat various illnesses. Machine learning models predict patient outcomes and personalize treatment plans based on individual genetic profiles. However, concerns about data privacy and the need for regulatory frameworks remain critical challenges in implementing AI healthcare solutions globally.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one advantage of using AI in medical imaging?
options: It eliminates the need for radiologists
It can detect diseases earlier than human radiologists
It is less expensive than traditional equipment
questions.explanation: 본문에서 AI 알고리즘이 인간 방사선사보다 빠르게 의료 이미지를 분석할 수 있고 암과 같은 질병을 더 초기 단계에서 감지할 수 있다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about AI in drug discovery?
options: It has failed to produce results
It can identify potential therapeutic compounds
It replaces all traditional research methods
questions.explanation: AI가 치료할 수 있는 잠재적 화합물을 식별함으로써 약물 발견을 지원한다고 본문에서 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What concern is mentioned about AI implementation in healthcare?
questions.explanation: 본문의 마지막 부분에서 데이터 프라이버시 우려와 규제 프레임워크의 필요성이 AI 의료 솔루션 구현의 중요한 과제로 언급되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: Remote work is more productive than working in an office environment?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장을 표현하며 2-3개의 주요 이유를 미리 제시합니다. (예: I strongly agree that remote work is more productive because...)
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유를 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다. (예: 재택근무는 출퇴근 시간 절약, 집중력 향상)
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유를 뒷받침하는 증거와 함께 제시합니다. (예: 유연한 업무 일정, 방해 요소 감소)
structure.conclusion: 처음 제시한 입장을 재확인하고 전체 논의를 요약하며 마무리합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to learn through practical hands-on experience. Others prefer to learn through lectures and reading. Which method do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I strongly prefer...
One reason is that hands-on learning allows me to...
Another advantage of this approach is that it helps...
sample_points: 실습 경험을 통한 학습은 이론을 실제 상황에 적용하게 하여 이해도를 높이고 장기 기억에 남긴다는 장점이 있습니다.
동시에 강의나 독서를 통한 학습은 광범위한 지식을 효율적으로 습득할 수 있으며, 기초 개념을 체계적으로 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

listening.title: Campus Library Services
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'm new to campus and I'm trying to find information about library services. Librarian: Welcome! I'd be happy to help. We offer extensive resources including over two million books, digital databases, and research journals. We also provide tutoring sessions, study rooms, and interlibrary loan services for books we don't have. Additionally, we've recently launched a new mobile app that allows you to search our catalog, renew materials, and access digital resources remotely. We're open 24 hours during exam periods. Student: That sounds great! Can I access databases from home? Librarian: Yes, absolutely. All registered students can access our databases remotely using their student ID and password. We also offer workshops on research skills and citation formats every month. If you need help navigating the system, our reference librarians are available in person or online.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To discuss the history of the library
To explain available library services to a new student
questions.explanation: 대화에서 사서가 신입 학생에게 도서관의 다양한 서비스(책, 데이터베이스, 튜터링, 앱 등)를 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following services does the library offer?
questions.explanation: 사서는 '시험 기간 중 24시간 운영'한다고 명시적으로 언급했습니다.

questions.q: How can students access library databases from home?
options: By using their student ID and password online
They cannot access databases from home
questions.explanation: 사서가 '학생들은 학번과 비밀번호를 사용하여 원격으로 데이터베이스에 접근할 수 있다'고 설명했습니다.
